name: claudecode-plus-mod
description: Claude Code Mod collection: prompt hygiene and more.

plugins.name: plus
plugins.description: All claudecode-plus-mod Mods in one install: prompt-shield, cache-guard, human-tone and clear-intent.

plugins.name: prompt-shield
plugins.description: Strip invisible fingerprint characters from outgoing prompts and audit what the model actually receives.

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Stabilize the prompt-cache prefix, audit compaction fidelity, and report real cache hit numbers per turn.

plugins.name: human-tone
plugins.description: Pin a house style into the system prompt: direct, human answers with no filler praise or over-formatting.

plugins.name: clear-intent
plugins.description: Attach an intent protocol to every prompt: restate the goal, separate confirmed from assumed, ask before acting on vague input.
